_comment: Stages of the team's GitHub notebooks. Cell numbers are 0-based positions in each .ipynb. The notebooks themselves are never modified; 'inject_after' runs extra assignment lines after a cell, 'replace' swaps exact literals in the cell source at run time only. Placeholders: {base} {monitor} {markers_csv} {platform_csv} {wells_dir} {workdir}. A replacement is skipped when its placeholder is empty.

notebooks.title: 4D ChronoSeis workflow
notebooks.summary: Match Baseline/Monitor, 4D difference, horizon autopicking from well markers, RMS / NdRMS / sweetness along horizons, hardening/softening classes.

inject_after.38:
_export(None)
print('[app] Called the 4D ChronoSeis export: class CSVs and maps saved.')

stages.title: Install / upgrade packages
stages.note: Runs %pip install -U on the shared environment. Only needed once.

stages.title: Gemma connection test
stages.note: Checks the hosted Gemma 4 endpoint answers. Not part of "Run full workflow": the app checks Gemma itself (Advisor status light). Run it on its own if wanted.

stages.title: Load & match Baseline / Monitor
stages.note: Loads both SEG-Y volumes, matches traces by inline/crossline, QC of geometry and NaNs.

stages.title: 4D difference volume
stages.note: Monitor minus Baseline, exported as SEG-Y with Baseline coordinates, plus matched geometry CSV.

stages.title: Seismic section viewer
stages.note: Interactive inline / crossline / time-slice viewer (ipywidgets).

stages.title: Monitor preconditioning (GPU)
stages.note: High-cut filter and two-pass structure-oriented smoothing with CuPy.

stages.title: Horizon setup & well-marker seeds
stages.note: Needs the combined well-marker CSV.

stages.title: Horizon autopicking
stages.note: Lateral-continuity NCC propagation for every marker horizon.

stages.title: Cycle-skip refinement & smoothing
stages.note: Hilbert phase / dip-plane refinement, then smoothing with inter-horizon separation.

stages.title: Use existing horizons (instead of picking)
stages.note: Reads horizon TXT files (tab-separated X, Y, Inline, Crossline, TWT) you already have and replaces the seeds, picking and refinement stages. Set 'Existing horizons' in step 2; the app does this automatically in 'Run full workflow'.

stages.title: Well overlay helper
stages.note: Reads well heads, checkshots and deviations from the well folder (used by later maps).

stages.title: Interactive horizon QC
stages.note: Section browser and TWT map (ipywidgets). Runs harmlessly in batch; use JupyterLab to interact.

stages.title: Export picked horizons
stages.note: Tab-separated X Y Inline Crossline TWT per horizon.

stages.title: RMS / dRMS / NdRMS along horizons + maps
stages.note: ±10 ms window around each horizon; maps saved per attribute.

stages.title: Sweetness and 4D sweetness change (GPU)
stages.note: Hilbert-based sweetness per horizon.

stages.title: 3×3 attribute map viewer
stages.note: Interactive viewer of RMS, dRMS, NdRMS and sweetness maps.

stages.title: Hardening / softening / unswept classes
stages.note: Platform-constrained, denoised 4D classes; the app then calls the engine's own export to save CSVs and maps. Runs on its own from the saved RMS/NdRMS files (no seismic, no GPU needed).

notebooks.title: Wells: physics-loss neural network (Phase 1)
notebooks.summary: Predicts interpreted log curves (porosity, saturation, volumes) from raw logs for Wells 4, 6, 7, validated leaving one well out.

stages.title: Discover files, read LAS, checkshot time conversion
Align depths, marker and physics features
Prediction helper for a new well

notebooks.title: Wells: lithology & fluid classes (Phases 2–3)
notebooks.summary: Lithology and coal beds from Phase 1 predictions, then reservoir / fluid classes. Needs the saved Phase 1 model.

notebooks.title: Wells: Phase 4, all 8 wells (marker similarity, TWT classes)
notebooks.summary: Deploys the trained Phase 1-3 model to the 8 wells and exports marker similarity and the seven-well reservoir classification in TWT. Reads the team's well files and trained bundle; writes only into your output folder.

stages.title: Load model, wells, checkshots, features
stages.note: Reads the team's LAS, markers, checkshots and the trained bundle.

stages.title: Predict lithology and fluid classes
stages.note: Includes the marker-similarity CSV export (Cell 9A).

stages.title: Save results and combine seven wells
stages.note: Cell 18 is the interactive QC; Cell 19 writes the TWT classification CSV.

notebooks.title: Wells: Phase 5, TWT correlation and fluid intervals
notebooks.summary: Correlates seven wells in TWT, proposes markers with X/Y and pairs oil/gas/water intervals with the nearest marker. Run Phase 4 first (or it reads the team's existing Phase 4 results).

stages.title: Convert to TWT and correlate wells
stages.note: Checkshot-based TWT conversion of all curves and markers.

stages.title: Interactive TWT QC
stages.note: Zoom and pan viewer.

stages.title: Export markers and fluid intervals
stages.note: Writes Phase5_Proposed_Markers_*.csv and Phase5_Fluid_Intervals_*.csv.

notebooks.title: Remaining Fluid Index (Phase 6 Part 3D)
notebooks.summary: Reuses the team's saved horizon attributes, then computes and exports the RFI map for every horizon. Reads the team's files; writes RFI only into your output folder (phase6_3D/RFI). CPU, no GPU.

stages.title: Settings, horizons and input checks
stages.note: Reads the horizon list, checks the matched SEG-Y headers and the sweetness cubes (a few minutes).

stages.title: Reuse saved horizon attributes
stages.note: Uses the team's saved *_3D_Attributes.csv instead of re-reading every trace (Cell 3, hours).

stages.title: Attribute QC
stages.note: Checks dRMS / NdRMS / NRMS against their formulas.

stages.title: Well trajectories and oil intervals
stages.note: Wells for the oil-proximity penalty.

stages.title: Compute and export RFI for every horizon
stages.note: Runs the notebook's own export for each horizon: <horizon>_RFI.csv + PNG.
